what: For each 9px cell across the screen, the cursor trail burns as dot characters (. · • o). Heat accumulates on a trail of 115 points that follow the cursor by .13 per frame (nearer the head, the larger the radius 4→38px and the weight), and each cell prints the character that matches its heat. Above .28 heat it takes the text color, above .58 the accent color, above .86 the lightened accent color. When the cursor stops, it cools at 1.2/s and fades away, and the characters shuffle and sparkle every .32s. On dark backgrounds they are layered by adding light (lighter). Off on touch screens and reduced motion

options.follow: Share of cursor followed (per frame), default .13
options.blend: lighter·source-over — default is chosen by background brightness
options.--fx-hi · --fx-lo · --fx-hot: Text color, faint text color, hot color (CSS variables), default --kf-ink · --kf-dim · --kf-accent
